FAQs

Quick answers

How fast can a water treatment project start? +

Most RO plant projects begin within 2–3 weeks of site survey, depending on scope and approvals.

Do you offer maintenance contracts for buildings? +

Yes — we run both scheduled preventive maintenance and on-call emergency repair contracts.

Is your honey lab-tested? +

Yes, both Sidr and Acacia honey are lab-verified for purity before they reach you.

How do I track my online order? +

Every order gets a tracking link by email and SMS.

Can you source products directly from China for us? +

Yes — we vet the factory, inspect quality before shipping, and handle customs clearance end to end.

What does a consultancy engagement look like? +

We start with a short scoping call, then propose a fixed-scope or retainer engagement — led by our CSCM-certified team.
